title: The Catacombs

Every chest holds Undead Essence (Wither Essence too from Floor III), and each floor has its own drops: Floor I Bonzo Fragments, the Red Nose, Balloon Snake, Bonzo's Mask and Staff; Floor II Scarf Fragments, Scarf's Studies and Thesis, the Adaptive Belt, Stone Blade and Red Scarf; Floor III the Adaptive armour, Suspicious Vial and Scarf's Grimoire; Floor IV Thorn Fragments, Spirit Wing, Bone and Decoy, the Spirit Bow and Sword, Thorn's Boots and Ultimate Rend; Floor V Livid Fragments, the Dark Orb, Shadow Assassin armour, Lethality VI, the Livid Dagger, AOTE Stone, Shadow Fury and Last Breath; Floor VI Giant Fragments, Sadan's Brooch, the Fel Skull, Soulweaver Gloves, Necromancer Sword and Lord Chestplate, Summoning Ring, Giant's Sword and Precursor Eye; Floor VII Wither armour, the Wither Cloak, Blood and Catalyst, Precursor Gear, Auto Recombobulator, Ultimate One For All, the three scrolls, Necron's Handle and the Lords' fish. Any floor can also give a Hot Potato or Fuming Potato Book, a Recombobulator 3000, a Kismet Feather or a Dungeon Chest Key. Better chests and a better rank make the rare ones likelier. in the Dungeon Hub: hold the item and talk to him. Each star costs essence (Wither Essence for most gear), as Hypixel's item says; some also cost coins or items. A starred item shows its stars after its name.
The other tab of Malik's screen spends essence on perks that work in the Catacombs (click one for its next level):
Undead perks cost 1,000 Undead Essence and up (to 50,000); Wither perks 100 Wither Essence and up.
Catacombs XP levels you up to 50 on Hypixel's table (50 XP for level 1 ... 569,809,640 in all); each level gives 20 SkyBlock XP (40 from level 40). Classes level the same way.
Not yet: more puzzles (Water Board, Ice Fill, Creeper Beams, Teleport Maze, Quiz, Boulder...), traps, ghost abilities, the dungeon map, Croesus.
